# Draft:Medieval Maronite rulers

The rulers of the Maronites held various titles throughout history, reflecting the community's evolving political and social structure. Initially, their leader was referred to as a "king" during the early Islamic conquests, later transitioning to the title of Emir (Prince) and eventually Muqaddam (chieftain). The Maronite Patriarch played a central role in governance, acting as both a spiritual and temporal authority who appointed these rulers.
